summary: Iteration 11 Help section frontend testing complete. Verified that /help is a public route (no auth required), renders all 13 documented sections with their TOC sidebar links, properly converts **bold** markdown to <strong> via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, supports anchor-based scroll navigation via TOC clicks, and that the help-back-btn (router.back) + help-back-to-dashboard-btn behave correctly. Regression: registered a fresh user, confirmed help-link-dashboard on the Dashboard header navigates to /help, opened a created document, confirmed help-link-editor in the editor toolbar navigates to /help. Zero console/page errors during the full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: HelpPage.js uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML for **bold** rendering. Content is hard-coded in SECTIONS array (not user input), so XSS risk is acceptable, but worth noting if any of these strings ever become user-editable in future iterations.

Mobile (<lg breakpoint) hides the TOC sidebar entirely (hidden lg:block) and the editor's help-link-editor is hidden on small screens. There is no alternative help entry-point exposed on mobile in the editor toolbar; consider exposing the help link in the mobile sidebar/menu for editor users on phones.

help-back-btn calls navigate(-1). If a user lands directly on /help via deep link with no history, router.back() falls back to a no-op. Acceptable, but a fallback navigate('/dashboard') could be safer.
test_credentials: Registered fresh user helptest_<timestamp>@test.com / TestPass123! via /api/auth/register (returned token + user). No persisted seeded credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 disposable test user and 1 throwaway document (title 'Help Test Doc') during regression run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 = pure frontend addition (HelpPage + help links in Dashboard/Editor headers). All targeted data-testids verified present and functional: help-intro, help-toc, help-back-btn, help-footer, help-back-to-dashboard-btn, all 13 help-section-{id}, all 13 help-toc-{id}, help-link-dashboard, help-link-editor. Bold markdown -> <strong> render via dangerouslySetInnerHTML confirmed (help-body-pipeline-0). No backend changes. /api/auth/register and /api/documents continue to return 200.
